title: Learning Generative Models with Sinkhorn Divergences
tldr_zh: 把 L 步 Sinkhorn 迭代当可自动微分的损失层，用 minibatch Sinkhorn loss 训练生成器；证 ε→0 得 OT、ε→∞ 得 MMD
tldr_en: Trains generators by backpropagating through L Sinkhorn iterations on minibatches; proves the Sinkhorn loss interpolates between OT (eps to 0) and MMD (eps to infinity).
key_numbers: CIFAR-10 Inception Score: Sinkhorn eps=1000 4.14+-0.06 vs MMD 4.04+-0.07; eps=100 3.09+-0.036; eps=10 3.11+-0.031 (Table 2)
Theorem 1: W_bar_{c,eps} -> 2 W_c as eps -> 0 and -> MMD_{-c} as eps -> infinity
MNIST: eps=1 with L=10 Sinkhorn iterations matches eps=0.1 with L=100; minibatch m=200 sufficient, m=10 poor (Fig. 3)
Empirical sample complexity R_{eps,d}(N) ~ N^{-kappa}: kappa ~ p/d for eps<1 (OT-like), kappa ~ 1 for eps>1 (MMD-like) (Appendix A.1, Fig. 5-6)
Iris ellipse fit: eps=0.1 diagonal counts 44/38/40 of 50 per class vs MMD 36/39/42 (Table 1)
